Milling & Size Reduction

Quadro Plansifter

Model KE 8 x 28

High-capacity plansifter for grading ground product.

Request a QuoteAdd to quote list

Prefer to talk? Call +1 (617) 380-9644.

Used in: Flour Milling and Grinding Systems, Cassava Processing Systems

Equipment overview

A multi-passage plansifter for high-capacity sifting at grain plants. Frame types can be changed to adjust how ground product is classified, and the internal structure is built to sanitary conditions with smooth walls that resist build-up.

Applications

  • High-capacity sifting at grain and flour plants
  • Classification of ground product

Functional features

  • Press equipment for compressing the screen frames
  • Sealed separation between screens
  • Frames can be removed easily
  • Centrifugal force adjustable with weights
  • Sanitary internal structure with smooth walls

Technical specifications

TypeKE, item 8 x 28
Number of passages8
Outlet bagØ 120 mm
Inlet bagØ 200 mm

Motor5.5 kW, 1000 rpm, with flange
